Closing wakes registered maintenance/service timer owners; active provider/socket/process/download/clipboard/microphone loops reject closing; outgoing sync queues are stopped and startup waits are interruptible. Queued pool/finalization/process-launch work drops captured resources without starting its body.

Normal GUI close and SIGINT/SIGTERM publish cancellation via GLib. Native teardown stops hotkeys, sync and actually owned servers, disconnects runtime producers, joins every registered actual handle and checkpoints encrypted storage outside GTK. Repeated signals remain handled during cleanup.
Headless service explicitly removes its poll source and releases its application hold rather than forgetting the hold and leaving capture/UI producers retained.
